name: video-library
title: Video library
description: A library of talks, demos and tutorials: 16:9 cards with a duration chip, speaker and date, grouped by playlist, as links or buttons for your own player.
docs: duration is written m:ss or h:mm:ss: it is shown as given, spoken in full by the card's link name (12 minutes 4 seconds) and added up into the playlist's total. thumbnail is a 16:9 picture URL; without one the card shows the first letter of the title. featured lets the first video lead the first playlist: two columns, and from 1024px two rows when the playlist has three or more videos (a playlist of three fills that block exactly). With onPlay the cards are buttons and href is ignored, so use that from a Client Component. A playlist without videos says so. Pass linkAs={Link} to route the links.
